q: The Principal Head of Department (PHOD) of the medical department on a zonal railway is the ___.

options.D: Medical Director of the Central Hospital

q: A Chief Head of Department (CHOD) exercises the same powers as a ___.
The Central Hospital of a zonal railway at headquarters is normally headed by a ___.
A divisional railway hospital is headed by the ___.
Which of the following is a recognised need for having the Model Schedule of Powers?

options.B: Ensuring uniformity of powers across zonal railways
options.C: Increasing the number of railway zones

q: The Model Schedule of Powers was first issued by the Railway Board on ___.
Which statement is true about the Model Schedule of Powers?

options.A: It provides a benchmark and uniformity of delegated powers across zonal railways
options.B: It applies only to the medical department
options.C: It abolishes the need for finance concurrence
options.D: It applies only to newly recruited officers

q: In MSOP 2018, Part B deals with ___.
Which of the following is NOT one of the stated needs for the MSOP?
Hospital committees in railway hospitals primarily function to ___.

options.C: Assist the hospital administration in smooth functioning and patient care
options.D: Sanction all purchases without any limit

q: Under the MSOP, the powers of a Chief Head of Department (CHOD) are ___.

options.A: The same as a Branch Officer's
options.B: The same as those of a PHOD

q: A correction slip to the MSOP is initiated by ___.
After vetting and finance concurrence, MSOP correction slips are issued by ___.

options.C: DGM(G) with the General Manager's personal approval

q: The nodal officer for MSOP correction slips on a zonal railway is ___.
Apart from the zonal railway, correction slips to the MSOP can also be issued by ___.
Before issue, a correction slip to the MSOP requires ___.

options.A: Finance advice of the Board only

q: Railway hospitals function as institutions providing ___.

options.D: Curative and preventive healthcare to railway beneficiaries

q: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about railway hospital administration?

options.B: Every purchase in a hospital needs no finance concurrence
options.C: The CMD is the PHOD of the medical department
options.D: CHODs exercise the same powers as PHODs

q: In medical administration on a zonal railway, the CMD exercises the powers of a ___.
In the delegation hierarchy, a JAG officer ranks ___ a Senior Scale officer.
The correct rank order of authorities from highest to lowest is ___.

options.A: DRM > GM > PHOD > JAG > Branch Officer
options.B: Branch Officer > Senior Scale > JAG > DRM > PHOD
options.C: GM > PHOD/CHOD > DRM > JAG > Senior Scale > Branch Officer
options.D: PHOD > GM > DRM > Branch Officer > JAG

q: Matters not specifically delegated in the MSOP are decided by ___.

options.D: The higher authority as per general delegation principles

q: The Model Schedule of Powers is best described as a ___.

options.B: Consolidation of delegated powers issued by the Railway Board

q: Which part of MSOP 2018 covers establishment matters?
Which part of MSOP 2018 covers stores matters?
On a zonal railway, whether drugs and surgical items are procured through the Stores department or the Medical department is decided by ___.

options.A: The Railway Board in every case

q: Rate contracts for medicines are generally entered into for ___.

options.C: Ensuring regular supply of commonly used drugs at pre-fixed rates

q: Local purchase of medicines is normally resorted to ___.

options.B: In emergencies or when regular supply channels fail

q: For procurement of drugs, finance concurrence is required ___.

options.B: Wherever the MSOP does not specifically mention that it is not required

q: A CMS needs a life-saving drug urgently which is not in stock. The correct course is ___.

options.A: Local purchase within delegated powers following prescribed procedure
options.B: Wait for the next rate contract
options.C: Borrow from a private hospital without record

q: Which of the following is NOT a recognised mode of drug procurement on railways?

options.C: Unrecorded cash purchase from any vendor

q: Bulk procurement of commonly used drugs on railways is generally done through ___.
The decision on the procurement channel for surgical items rests with ___.
Which statement is true about local purchase of medicines?

options.A: It is done only by the General Manager
options.B: It is meant for genuine emergent needs following prescribed procedure
options.C: It replaces the rate contract system

q: Procurement procedures for drugs and surgical items aim to ensure ___.
Where the MSOP specifically mentions that finance concurrence is not required for a procurement, ___.

options.A: The purchase can proceed without finance concurrence
options.C: The General Manager must still approve every bill

q: Surgical consumables required regularly in large quantities are best procured through ___.
In case of failure of supply against a rate contract, the hospital administration may ___.

options.A: Arrange alternative supply as per delegated powers

q: Emergency local purchase powers are exercised ___.

options.C: Without any limit by all officers
options.D: Within the delegated powers of the competent medical authority

q: Rate contracts help the railway administration because ___.

options.C: Prices are pre-fixed and supply is assured for the contract period
options.D: They eliminate the need for doctors

q: Which is NOT correct about drug procurement on railways?

options.A: The railway decides the procurement channel

q: Tender procedures in drug procurement are intended to ensure ___.
Medicines for railway hospitals should be procured from ___.

options.A: Approved and reliable sources as per procedure

q: The presumption rule of the MSOP regarding finance concurrence means ___.

options.A: Concurrence is required only for medical matters
options.B: Concurrence is presumed required unless specifically stated otherwise

q: Emergency procurement of medicines is justified on the ground of ___.
Which statement is true?

options.A: Procurement is done by the patients themselves
options.B: Each railway decides whether drug procurement is through the Stores or the Medical department
options.C: The Stores department always procures drugs on every railway
options.D: The Medical department always procures drugs on every railway

q: Proper documentation of local purchases is necessary for ___.

options.D: Audit, accountability and settlement of claims

q: When a new drug is to be added to the hospital formulary, the decision is taken ___.

options.A: By the competent medical authority as per delegation

q: Which of the following best describes a rate contract?

options.D: A contract fixing rates for supply of specified items over a period

q: In drug procurement, the role of finance concurrence is to ___.

options.C: Ensure financial propriety of the expenditure

q: Railway beneficiaries may be referred to private hospitals when ___.

options.B: The facility is not available in railway hospitals and referral is sanctioned by the competent authority

q: Powers to sanction referral of patients to recognised private hospitals are delegated to ___.

options.A: Medical officers as per the delegation hierarchy

q: A recognised hospital for railway referral means ___.

options.A: A private hospital recognised or empanelled by the railway for treatment of railway beneficiaries
options.C: A hospital chosen only by the patient

q: A CMS wants to refer a patient to a recognised private hospital for specialised treatment not available in the railway hospital. He can do so ___.

options.A: Only with Railway Board approval in every case
options.C: Only if the patient pays first
options.D: Within his delegated powers, following prescribed procedure

q: Emergency referral to the nearest hospital is permitted when ___.

options.A: The patient demands a specific doctor
options.C: Delay would endanger the patient's life
options.D: The railway hospital is far by the patient's choice

q: Which statement is true about referral powers?

options.A: Only the General Manager can refer patients
options.B: They are exercised within delegated powers by competent medical authorities
options.C: Every referral needs Railway Board sanction

q: The Medical Director (MD) of a Central Hospital exercises powers ___.

options.A: Only with Board approval each time
options.B: As delegated under the MSOP for hospital administration

q: A Chief Medical Superintendent (CMS) heading a divisional hospital exercises ___.

options.C: Delegated administrative and financial powers as per the MSOP

q: Which is NOT correct about medical officer delegations?

options.A: Powers are delegated in a hierarchy
options.B: Finance concurrence is presumed required unless exempted
options.D: A Branch Officer can exercise the General Manager's powers

q: Referral sanctions must be supported by ___.
When specialised treatment is available in the railway hospital itself, referral to a private hospital ___.
The power to sanction referral is higher for ___.

options.D: Higher authorities in the medical hierarchy

q: In a medical emergency, the priority of the railway medical officer is ___.

options.B: Saving the patient's life, with ex-post-facto sanction as per rules
options.C: Waiting for written sanction before any action

q: Which of the following correctly orders officers by seniority in the medical hierarchy?
Delegation of powers to medical officers aims at ___.

options.A: Centralising all decisions with the Board
options.D: Quick decision-making in patient care and administration

q: A medical officer sanctioning referral must ensure ___.

options.B: That the patient is not informed
options.C: That the case genuinely needs referral and rules are followed
options.D: That the private hospital is the costliest

q: Which statement is true about referral of railway beneficiaries?

options.B: Referral is generally to recognised or empanelled hospitals as per rules
options.C: Referral to non-recognised hospitals is the norm

q: The competent authority for referral sanctions at the divisional hospital level is generally ___.

options.A: The CMS or CMO in charge, within delegated powers

q: Medical officers exercise financial powers ___.

options.C: Subject to finance concurrence where required under the MSOP

q: Which of the following is NOT a valid ground for referral to a private recognised hospital?

options.B: The patient's mere preference without medical justification
options.C: Non-availability of the facility in railway hospitals

q: After emergency treatment at a private hospital, the railway medical authority ___.

options.D: Examines the case for regularisation as per rules

q: The hierarchy GM > PHOD/CHOD > DRM > JAG > Senior Scale > Branch Officer implies that ___.

options.A: Higher authorities can exercise the powers of lower authorities
options.B: Lower authorities can overrule higher ones
options.D: Hierarchy does not matter in delegation

q: A CMO's referral sanction is valid when ___.

options.C: It is within his delegated powers and follows procedure

q: Recognition or empanelment of private hospitals is done ___.

options.B: By the railway administration as per prescribed procedure

q: Which of the following best describes delegation under the MSOP?

options.A: Authorisation of a lower authority to exercise specified powers

q: Procurement of medical equipment for railway hospitals is done ___.

options.D: As per delegated powers, with finance concurrence where required

q: AMC in the context of medical equipment stands for ___.
Annual Maintenance Contracts for medical equipment are entered into to ___.

options.D: Ensure upkeep and prompt repair of equipment

q: Which statement is true about medical equipment procurement?

options.A: Technical specifications are framed by competent medical or technical authorities
options.B: Any model can be bought without specifications

q: A CMS wants an AMC for a costly diagnostic machine. He should ___.

options.C: Process it within delegated powers, with finance concurrence where required

q: Which is NOT correct about AMCs?

options.B: They need no monitoring once signed
options.C: They cover maintenance and repairs for a defined period
options.D: They are entered into with competent sanction

q: Before procuring costly medical equipment, the hospital should assess ___.

options.B: Only the colour of the machine

q: Procurement of medical equipment through proper tendering ensures ___.
An AMC generally covers ___.

options.C: Preventive maintenance and breakdown repairs as per contract terms

q: Medical equipment procurement is sanctioned by ___.

options.C: The competent authority as per the delegation hierarchy

q: Comprehensive and non-comprehensive AMCs differ in ___.

options.B: Whether spares are included in the contract scope

q: Equipment procurement proposals require finance concurrence ___.

options.A: Wherever not specifically exempted under the MSOP

q: Which of the following statements about equipment purchase procedure is true?

options.A: Medical equipment can be procured without assessing need
options.B: Only the cheapest equipment is always the best
options.C: Installation is not the railway's concern
options.D: Need assessment and technical vetting precede equipment purchase

q: Timely renewal of AMCs is important because ___.

options.D: Gaps in maintenance affect patient care

q: The competent medical authority for equipment decisions at the headquarters hospital level is generally ___.

options.A: The MD or CMD, within delegated powers

q: Which of the following is NOT a good practice in equipment procurement?

options.C: Splitting orders to avoid sanction limits

q: Installation and commissioning of medical equipment should be ___.

options.A: Done only after full payment in every case
options.B: Verified before final payment as per the contract

q: User training on new medical equipment is ___.

options.D: Desirable for safe and effective use

q: Which statement is true about proprietary equipment?

options.B: Only one brand exists in every case
options.C: Procurement follows prescribed procedure with proper justification
options.D: It can be bought without any justification

q: The performance of AMC vendors should be ___.

options.B: Monitored for response time and service quality

q: Emergency procurement of a critical equipment spare is justified by ___.

options.A: Urgency of patient care, within delegated powers

q: In equipment purchase, the nature of expenditure as revenue or capital is ___.
Standardisation of equipment models across hospitals helps in ___.
A medical officer proposing equipment purchase must ___.

options.C: Justify the need and follow delegation and finance rules

q: Which of the following is NOT correct about medical equipment and AMCs?

options.A: Medical equipment can be bought on verbal orders without record
options.D: Finance concurrence is presumed required unless exempted
